method: per-snapshot null: re-cluster after removing 10% of post-merge clustering-eligible edges (real MiniLM embeddings via subset matching); each transition tested against both endpoint nulls, conservative p = max, Holm-adjusted across transitions
interpretation: 0/3 transitions are more stable than their own snapshots' 10%-edge-removal noise after Holm correction. The earlier claim that 2022->2024 is robustly stable (p=0.03) came from comparing against the 2026 null, which is much less stable than the 2022/2024 nulls, and is withdrawn.
caveat_not_equivalent_sized: perturbation removes 10% of edges; real growth adds 40-92% across these transitions -- not a matched-magnitude comparison
